company.shortDescription: Orchestra is an IT company that develops software for scientists, clinicians, and consumers.
company.description: Orchestra BioMed is a biomedical innovation company that develops therapeutic products for procedure-based medicine. The company collaborates with medical device companies to advance its product candidates. Orchestra BioMed's pipeline includes BackBeat Cardiac Neuromodulation Therapy™ (BackBeat CNT™), an investigational treatment for hypertension, and Virtue® Sirolimus AngioInfusion™ Balloon (Virtue SAB), a drug/device combination product for treating artery disease.
